Wellington Shields Capital Management Llc bought 1,856 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 88,337 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $14.95M, up from 86,481 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Wellington Shields Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $823.61 billion market cap company.
